card.name: Funding and support acknowledgments
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation in funding credits, donation appeals, and closing notes on web pages, such as 'generosity', 'gift', or the period after a list of thanked names. It also appears in contact and registry details at the end of pages.

modes.label: Funding thanks
modes.description: Words in credits that thank donors, grant funders, or sponsors.
modes.example: This work is made possible by the<< generosity>> of individual donors and congregations.

modes.label: Sentence end after credits
modes.description: A period after a byline or list of thanked people, just before a funding or research note.
modes.example: Anne Custance, and Anne Emery<<. >>This study was supported by a grant from

modes.label: Contact and link notes
modes.description: Words or digits in page footers about outside links or phone numbers.
modes.example: Links to<< other>> sites are provided for information only

card.plain: It marks the end-of-page text that thanks funders or gives contact details.
